person.name: Lydia J. Harmon
person.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-27 from profile 9928.] Lydia J. Harmon, b. 30 Jul 1848, d. 28 Oct 1927 (aged 79), wife of Simon Harmon (b. abt 1835). Split off profile 9928 (Lydia J Harmon, 1776-1851) under Jequan Davis's conflation ruling of 2026-11-22. Her birth and death rest on the Davis Family Tree GEDCOM alone; the Simon Harmon marriage (relationship and the generic marriage fact 25647) moved with her, as a husband born abt 1835 fits a wife born 1848 and cannot fit the 1776-1851 woman. The parentage formerly on 9928 (Raymond Harmon, b. abt 1902, and Hattie Miller, b. 1905) fits neither woman and was detached to the package's unassigned-evidence register, held as a couple. Research is queued as item 3 of the split research register. Flagged unproven.
